pairing.scope_note: Saved source/seed alignment; not a proof of identical latent state, random-number consumption, or native interventions.

bootstrap.method: Hold all 50 tasks fixed and equally weighted; resample 10 source positions with replacement independently within each task. Reuse identical draws for all five methods and four paired contrasts.
bootstrap.confidence_interval: Pointwise percentile 2.5/97.5%; numpy.quantile default linear interpolation; not multiplicity-adjusted.
bootstrap.relationship_to_main_table: Same statistical convention, replicate count and seed. This standalone analysis specifies its own draw ordering and does not claim bitwise reuse of a persisted main-table draw array.
bootstrap.limits: Conditional on fixed 50 tasks and empirical 10 sources/task; excludes task-population and model-training-seed uncertainty. All-zero/all-one strata have zero empirical within-task variation.

exact_test.raw_p_values: Unadjusted; conditional matched-outcome test, no asymptotic approximation.
exact_test.multiplicity: Holm-adjusted p also supplied for these four comparisons only; not campaign-wide.
exact_test.rescue_harm_definition: Relative to VLA-Corrector: rescued = tested method success and VLA-Corrector failure; harmed = tested method failure and VLA-Corrector success. These labels are paired outcomes, not causal attribution to an individual intervention.

external_provenance.recovered_status: Accepted binary terminal success from original saved log evidence; remains distinct from direct raw RESULT.
external_provenance.cost_note: All 500 outcomes enter success comparisons. Missing costs for eight recovered episodes remain null; progress infer_req or meltdowns are not substituted for sampling/flow/intervention counters. No cost or latency superiority is inferred here.

interpretation_limits.corrector_training_scope: Frozen historical five-task D/G0/Q transferred to MT50; not a statement about pi05 backbone pretraining.
interpretation_limits.external_training_scope: Separate native detector checkpoint; this saved-episode analysis does not establish identical training data, coverage, updates, or tuning effort. Do not describe this as a matched-training-data comparison.

native_intervention_protocol.VLA-Corrector_threshold_rule: Native adaptive threshold with native hard retrigger preserved

interpretation_limits.scientific_claim_boundary: H10 fixed-source comparison of the completed systems as configured. Positive paired differences do not establish a uniform task-wise, training-matched, compute-matched, intervention-budget-matched, or all-H superiority. No method, task, threshold, or H selected using these outcomes.
